name: vercel_deploy_error_is_admin_not_job
subject: Fix Deployment Error for 'shop-atlas'
snippet: Your latest deployment of shop-atlas failed during the Build step. The build exited with code 1. Review the logs and redeploy once resolved.
notes: Regression: a CI/CD deployment failure was themed `job` because a deploy is a build 'job'. It is operational/technical work → admin.

name: github_actions_build_failed_is_admin_not_job

snippet: The build job in workflow CI failed on commit a1b2c3d. 1 job failed, 0 cancelled. See the run for details.
